test_only_caveats.vitest_esm_module_isolation: vitest+Vite ESM may create distinct module instances for the sink file when imported via different absolute paths (e.g. @cline/core → index.ts → re-export vs sibling relative). In production (Node CommonJS or esbuild ESM), this DOES NOT happen. The SLAC-CALLER-RACE and SLAC-LSR tests verify AsyncLocalStorage propagation end-to-end by using the runtime's same-module consumer closure. SLAC-COMPOSE-PRODUCTION-01 verifies the real production wrapper pipeline but aggregates byCaller cardinality rather than asserting a specific class bucket.
